Focused lane for AC-017 only, split from the core release on 2026-11-13. At the release candidate the perf check measured overall p95 5490.8 ms at TOGAVSU_PERF_N=20 against the 300 ms target on the 1M-row seed, and every listed admin API read exceeded the target; three earlier release passes did not move it. Profile before changing code: run the perf check, capture EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) for each slow read, and name the cause of each (missing indexes, sequential scans, N+1 queries, unbounded counts, per-row permission or wall checks, missing pagination limits, pool settings). Then fix those causes in the query and data-access code and migrations: indexes, query rewrites, keyset pagination where the contract allows it, batching. Never relax the 300 ms target, shrink the seed, lower TOGAVSU_PERF_N, cache around permission or wall checks, or leave a read out of the measurement. The Full acceptance CI job has no time limit of its own; if seeding the 1M rows is slow, make seeding faster (COPY in one transaction), never smaller.
